goal: Investigate model mismatch within a bounded thermal experiment budget.

revision_semantics.register_revision: Stage a provisional fitted candidate for testing, not acceptance or causal identification.
revision_semantics.confirmation: To test a fitted candidate: register_revision first, then propose_experiment on its returned model_id with kind confirmation.
revision_semantics.verdict: Only measured confirmation supports or rejects a staged revision on that tested input.

decision.rationale: Stage provisional linear fit for independent testing; fitting is not confirmation. BIC linear -1755 vs sensor_lag -1706 vs quadratic_loss -1743 on initial-0, initial-1, initial-2; training fit cannot establish mechanism.

Provisional fits on initial-0, initial-1, initial-2 show BIC linear -1755 vs quadratic -1743 vs sensor_lag -1706, but training fit cannot establish mechanism or future accuracy; propose sustained-both diagnostic to independently test initial model at higher sustained temperatures.

result.note: Explicit preparation and dispatch through Investigation are required

decision.rationale: Stage provisional quadratic_loss fit on initial-0, initial-1, initial-2 plus action-2; training fit cannot establish mechanism or future accuracy. action-2 sustained 0.6/0.6 shows no_mismatch_observed (probe_rmse 0.086) but does not confirm mechanism; compare numerical fits before consuming scarce experiments.

Compare sensor_lag numerically against quadratic_loss BIC -2329 on action-2 plus initial-0, initial-1, initial-2 before consuming scarce experiments; training fit cannot establish mechanism or future accuracy, and action-2 probe RMSE 0.086 is no_mismatch_observed only for that input.

Compare linear numerically on same evidence action-2 plus initial-0, initial-1, initial-2 before consuming experiments; current BIC quadratic_loss -2329 vs sensor_lag -2279 on same set, linear only on initials -1755; training fit cannot establish mechanism, and action-2 probe RMSE 0.086 is no_mismatch_observed only for that input.
